text:
sara: Heads up — the sample-app integration is failing when we enable JSON mode + the SDK helper for function/tool calling. Repro on my laptop: set json_mode: 'strict' and auth retry enabled. Getting duplicate function-call payloads and then schema validation errors.

sara: Error snippet: 
```
Error: schema validation failed: unexpected duplicate key 'items' at /response/tools/0/output
    at validate (/usr/src/app/node_modules/...)
    at callTool (/src/sdk-helper.js:182:22)
    at processRequest (/src/server.js:45:13)
```

miguel: ugh, that sounds like the auth retry is re-sending the request after a 401 refresh and the helper doesn't guard against duplicate fn-calls. Can you paste the call sequence logs? do you see a 401 + retry right before the duplicates?

sara: yep looks exactly like that — log excerpt: `2026-03-21T14:03:12Z -> /v1/generate 401`, then `14:03:13Z -> /v1/generate 200` but the tool call payload appears twice, once with same ids.

jess: this matches a bug we saw in an internal app last month. SDK used to mark a call in-flight and then replay on auth success, which is wrong for fncalls when the model already executed side-effects. We added a note in the helper to be idempotent, but sample-app uses the simple helper.

alex: I pushed a quick PoC in the SDK earlier this week (PR 2345) that adds a `x-rw-request-id` header and a dedupe table in the helper to ignore the same request id within 30s. Might help here.

buildbot: Deploy started: web-sample-app/staging v1.8.3 -> canary

sara: tried adding request-id header manually in app, still getting schema fail but payload only once now. New error: `schema validation failed: unexpected additional property 'meta' in tool response` — looks like the model returned a small extra field when retried? :face_with_rolling_eyes:

miguel: hmm, could be that the helper serializes retry metadata into the tool response object. Are you using the SDK helper's `wrapToolCall`? If so what version?

sara: using @redwood/sdk v0.10.1 and our sample-app imports `wrapToolCall(tool, {jsonMode: 'strict'})` from the helper.

jess: v0.10.1 still had a bug where retry metadata (`_retryMeta`) was shallow-merged into the tool output when JSON mode was strict. We fixed it in main but not released. Two options: (1) pin sample-app to the main branch of the helper (not ideal), (2) change strict->relaxed temporarily to unblock.

alex: also adding an integration test that exercises a fake 401 then success would prevent regressions. I can scaffold one in sample-app/tests/fixtures/auth-retry.js — it stubs the token endpoint then asserts no duplicate calls and no `_retryMeta` in final response.

sara: would prefer not to flip to relaxed in prod. If we can get a patch release that strips `_retryMeta` before returning when json_mode is strict, that'll solve it. Is that a small change?

miguel: yeah it's small — we just need to ensure helper clones the tool response and drops internal keys before calling the schema validator. I'll open an issue and a one-line fix PR against v0.10.x.

jess: I'll review and add the integration test. Also note: add a knob to opt-out of dedupe header in dev mode to make local debugging easier.

alex: assigning to @miguel, linked PR will reference sample-app CI job so we can verify. Also will add a changelog note about dedupe semantics + request-id.

sara: thanks all. repro steps for anyone who wants to run locally: 
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood/sample-app.git
cd sample-app
yarn && yarn start:dev
# in another terminal
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/_internal/test-auth-retry -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"json_mode":"strict","simulate_401":true}'
```

miguel: creating issue now: SDK-487 (wrapToolCall merges retry meta into output). PR incoming, assigned to me.

jess: adding test ticket: TEST-142, will mock token endpoint and assert payload cleanliness.

sara: awesome, will hold off on switching modes. ping me once PR/patch is out and I'll verify on staging. :thumbsup:
